title: Terms and Conditions for Referral Program
description: Referrals are valid only for drivers who have never been part of the Everest Fleet system in any capacity. Referred individuals must meet all eligibility…
html:
• Referrals are valid only for drivers who have never been part of the Everest Fleet system in any capacity.
  • Referred individuals must meet all eligibility criteria and complete the onboarding process successfully.
  • Payouts will only be processed after the referred driver completes their first trip with Everest Fleet.
  • If the referred driver fails to meet this condition, the referral will not be eligible for a payout.
  • Everest Fleet reserves the right to verify the authenticity of referrals and may disqualify those found to be invalid.
  • Any disputes regarding the referral program shall be subject to the company’s final decision.
  • This program may be modified or discontinued at the discretion of Everest Fleet without prior notice.
